name: Sound bank reload fix
description: Keeps the player, weapon, menu and music sounds when the game reloads its main sound banks after choosing the user (they could stay silent, mostly at 60 FPS).
title: CUSA03023

bindings.name: mo_system_slot
bindings.evidence: eboot+0x56c7f50 (RW data): MagicOrchestra FMOD system singleton pointer, read by its getter eboot+0x27f0740 (lazily created at boot, before any sound bank exists). The object's vtable is eboot+0x52cfae0; slot +0x330 (eboot+0x27f65c0) checks under the system's lock whether a bank with the given name is registered.

bindings.name: mo_bank_table_has_name
bindings.prototype: bool mo_bank_table_has_name(void* table, const char* name)
bindings.evidence: eboot+0x27dcb20: MagicOrchestra bank table (system+0x220) lookup. Under the table lock (+0xa8) walks the live bank handles (+0x10..+0x18, slots at +0x38) and compares each bank's name (bank vtable +0xb0) with `name`; returns true on a match whatever the bank state. eboot+0x27d5b30 calls it with system+0x220 before loading a bank.

hooks.name: mo_release_bank_by_name
hooks.evidence: eboot+0x27d6110: MagicOrchestra release-bank-by-name request. Returns 2 when the system is not initialised, else queues a type-8 'SMOM' command through system vtable +0x128 and returns 0 (queued) or 6. Called by the sound bank resource destructor eboot+0x1f86bc0 with the bank name. Prologue push rbp / mov rbp,rsp / push rbx / push rax; no branch target inside.

hooks.name: sound_bank_load_project
hooks.prototype: void original_SoundBankLoadProject(unsigned char* resource, void* step)
hooks.evidence: eboot+0x1f87960: 'load project' state of the sound bank resource state machine, called by the step function eboot+0x1f89320 through its state table with (this, step argument). Calls eboot+0x27d5b30, which returns 1 without loading while a bank with the name at resource+0x128 (std::string, capacity at +0x140) is registered or in the bank table, then advances the state. Returning without calling it keeps the state, so the step runs again on the next update. Prologue push rbp / mov rbp,rsp / push rbx / push rax.

hooks.name: sound_bank_preload_fsb
hooks.prototype: void original_SoundBankPreloadFsb(unsigned char* resource, void* step)
hooks.evidence: eboot+0x1f873f0: 'preload FSB' state of the same state machine (this = resource, name at +0x128): creates the MagicOrchestra FSB object and registers it with FMOD EventSystem::preloadFSB by file name (eboot+0x27d68b8 -> eboot+0x280f6e5), then advances. Runs before the 'load project' state. Prologue push rbp / mov rbp,rsp / push r15.
